entities.name: Quickened toys
entities.description: Previously inanimate objects on Duskmourn that gained sentience and an appetite for death through Valgavoth's warping influence.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: Plane on which quickened toys exist.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: Entity whose warping influence quickens toys on Duskmourn.

events.summary: Quickened toys wait to be picked up, then strike when the group drops its guard, going dormant after eliminating it.
events.quote: waiting for the perfect moment when everyone in the group has dropped their guards before striking

relations.note: His warping influence gave toys sentience and an appetite for death.
